description_en: Calls the UpdateAutoThrottleRulesAsync operation to asynchronously configure automatic SQL throttling parameters for specified database instances in batches
description_zh: 调用UpdateAutoThrottleRulesAsync接口，采用异步方式，批量设置指定数据库实例的自动SQL限流配置参数
name: UpdateAutoThrottleRulesAsync

parameters.help_en:
The database instance IDs.

The data format is JSONArray, such as `['Instance ID 1','Instance ID 2']`. Separate instance IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh:
数据库实例ID。

数据格式为JSONArray，例如`['实例ID1','实例ID2']`，实例ID间用英文逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: instance_ids

parameters.help_en: The CPU utilization threshold. Valid values: 70% to 100%
parameters.name: cpu_usage

parameters.help_en:
The logical relationship between the CPU utilization threshold and the active sessions threshold. Valid values:
AND: both conditions must be met.
OR: either condition must be met
parameters.help_zh:
CPU利用率阈值和活跃会话数阈值的逻辑关系。
AND：且。
OR：或
parameters.name: cpu_session_relation

parameters.help_en:
The active sessions threshold.

If the relationship with the CPU utilization threshold is OR, the value must be greater than or equal to 16.
If the relationship with the CPU utilization threshold is AND, the value must be greater than or equal to 2
parameters.help_zh:
活跃会话数阈值。

与CPU利用率阈值关系为OR（或）时，大于等于16。
与CPU利用率阈值关系为AND（且）时，大于等于2
parameters.name: active_sessions

parameters.help_en: The duration threshold of the anomaly that triggers automatic SQL throttling. The value must be a positive integer greater than or equal to 2. Unit: minutes
parameters.help_zh: 触发自动SQL限流的异常的持续时间阈值，取值范围：大于等于2的正整数，单位：分钟
parameters.name: abnormal_duration

parameters.help_en: The maximum throttling duration. The value must be a positive integer. Unit: minutes
parameters.help_zh: 最大限流时长，取值为正整数，单位：分钟
parameters.name: max_throttle_time

parameters.help_en: The start time of the throttling time window (UTC)
parameters.help_zh: 可限流时间段的开始时间（UTC时间）
parameters.name: allow_throttle_start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the throttling time window (UTC)
parameters.help_zh: 可限流时间段的结束时间（UTC时间）
parameters.name: allow_throttle_end_time

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to simultaneously kill abnormal SQL statements that are being executed.
Abnormal SQL statements are those that match the SQL templates to be throttled.

Valid values:
true: Yes.
false: No
parameters.help_zh:
是否同时KILL执行中的异常SQL：
异常SQL：与需要限流的SQL模板相同。

true：是。
false：否
parameters.name: auto_kill_session

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the asynchronous request.
An asynchronous call does not immediately return complete results. First, call this operation to obtain the ResultId. Then, use the returned ResultId to initiate the call again until isFinish is true, at which point the complete results are returned. This means that you must call this operation at least twice to obtain complete data
parameters.help_zh:
异步请求的ID。
异步调用后不会立即返回完整结果，首先需要调用该接口获取ResultId，然后使用返回数据的ResultId，重新发起调用，直到isFinish取值为true时，返回完整结果。即获取一次完整数据，至少需要调用该接口两次
parameters.name: result_id
